quand: Sent by the Circle role when a loyal client enters the Circle: once only.

blocs.texte:
Hello {prenom},

You are one of the women who have worn Awrea Paris from the start, and the Maison wanted to tell you so: today you join the Circle.
You will discover the next pieces before anyone else, and the designer keeps a special attention for you.

With all our gratitude,
The designer
